#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

int main() {
    std::string lineCount;
    std::getline(std::cin, lineCount);
    std::string inputString;
    std::getline(std::cin, inputString);

    int maxLength = 0;
    int countTokens = 0;
    size_t index = 0;
    size_t lastParenIndex = 0;

    while (true) {
        size_t startIdx = inputString.find('(', index);
        if (startIdx == std::string::npos) {
            break;
        }
        size_t endIdx = inputString.find(')', startIdx);
        if (endIdx == std::string::npos) {
            break;
        }

        std::string segment = inputString.substr(lastParenIndex, startIdx - lastParenIndex);
        std::istringstream segmentStream(segment);
        std::string token;
        while (std::getline(segmentStream, token, '_')) {
            if (token.length() > maxLength) {
                maxLength = token.length();
            }
        }

        std::string inside = inputString.substr(startIdx + 1, endIdx - startIdx - 1);
        std::istringstream insideStream(inside);
        while (insideStream >> token) {
            if (!token.empty()) {
                countTokens++;
            }
        }

        lastParenIndex = endIdx + 1;
        index = endIdx + 1;
    }

    // Process remaining part after last closing parenthesis
    std::string remaining = inputString.substr(lastParenIndex);
    std::istringstream remainingStream(remaining);
    std::string token;
    while (remainingStream >> token) {
        size_t pos = 0;
        while ((pos = token.find('_')) != std::string::npos) {
            token.erase(pos, 1);
        }
        if (token.length() > maxLength) {
            maxLength = token.length();
        }
    }

    std::cout << maxLength << " " << countTokens << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
